title: The Wizard School Dropout Club
subtitle: A Story About Finding Your Own Kind of Magic
blurb: Marnie Pennywhistle has just been expelled from Humbleton Academy of Practical Wizardry for turning the Principal's hat into a goose. She finds three more misfits hiding in the old Potting Shed: a boy whose spells work backwards, a girl who can only conjure socks, and a troll who is allergic to magic. When the school's perfect students all turn into garden gnomes, the Dropout Club discovers that every useless thing about them is exactly what the school needs.
